entities.summary: Venko Andonovski is a Macedonian writer, essayist, critic and literary theorist. Known for his contributions to contemporary Macedonian literature. His work spans multiple literary genres, including fiction, drama and literary criticism, and has been widely published and translated. In addition to his literary career he’s also an academic and professor of literature.
